newsitem.title: FRANCE: Callebaut cuts Seita stake further.
newsitem.headline: Callebaut cuts Seita stake further.

text.p: Tobacco group Seita said on Thursday that Barry Callebaut France had sold a 0.3 percent stake in the company to Societe Suisse d'Assurances and now held a 0.2 percent stake.
Societe Suisse d'Assurances brought its stake to four percent from 3.5 percent through the Callebaut deal and by buying on the market.

Both Callebaut and Societe Suisse are part of the group of core shareholders in Seita. Callebaut cut its stake to 0.5 percent from 1.5 percent on July 3 also by selling to Societe Suisse d'Assurances.
Barry Callebaut is a unit of Zurich-based Klaus J Jacobs Holding. It was formed earlier this year through a merger of Cacao Barry SA and Callebaut AG.
Seita said its core shareholders now held 25.95 percent.

Geneval has five percent, Financiere Sipa four percent, Societe Suisse d'Assurances four percent, Credit Commercial de France CCF 2.5 percent, La Francaise des Jeux 2.5 percent, Sofinamm 2.5 percent, Cie Saint Gabriel 1.5 percent, Penthievre Holding BV 1.5 percent, Cie Navigation Mixte 0.75 percent and Barry Callebaut 0.2 percent.
